newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rice export prices seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rice export prices seen steady.

text.p: Pakistani rice export prices are likely to remain steady in the trading week starting Saturday with foreign demand low, dealers said on Thursday.
"Rice prices are likely to remain steady next week on low demand from buyers abroad," said an official of the state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan.
The 1996/97 (July-June) crops of both basmati and IRRI-6 varieties were good, but buyers abroad had not yet started big purchases, the official said.
Prices in the domestic markets remained stable as exporters' demand was low, he said.
